import idautils, ida_bytes, ida_funcs, idc
ids = [1000,1001,1002,1007,1005,1006,1009]
# map ea -> set of ids found
from collections import defaultdict
hits = defaultdict(set)
for imm in ids:
    for ea in idautils.Heads():
        pass
# better: use ida find_imm
import ida_search
for imm in ids:
    ea = 0
    while True:
        ea = ida_search.find_imm(ea, ida_search.SEARCH_DOWN, imm)
        if ea == ida_search.BADADDR or ea == -1:
            break
        f = ida_funcs.get_func(ea)
        if f:
            hits[f.start_ea].add(imm)
        ea += 1
        if ea > 0xA00000:
            break
# score by how many of our ids appear
ranked = sorted(((len(v), hex(k), sorted(v)) for k,v in hits.items()), reverse=True)
# focus near StatusBar region or high score
out = []
for score, addr, found in ranked:
    if score >= 3:
        name = idc.get_func_name(int(addr,16))
        size = ida_funcs.get_func(int(addr,16)).size()
        out.append(f"{score} {addr} {name} size={hex(size)} ids={found}")
print("\n".join(out[:40]))
